entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“There are two main distinctions be..."
entries.dialogueText: “There are two main distinctions between these projects. It's either we improve our poor infrastructure or we invest in increasing production.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: ""Currency health and economic outpu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Currency health and economic output degraded significantly and nearly crashed the Sordish Ren. Our currency is on the course to actually crash if we don't act."

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“Catastrophic losses in our financi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Catastrophic losses in our financial strength are observed at the Central Bank. Especially compared to pre-election levels, inflation has increased by twenty percentage points year on year this quarter.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“We have enough of a budget to surv..."
entries.dialogueText: “We have enough of a budget to survive this crisis for some time. In order to navigate the financial repercussions of Black Tuesday, we must act in a fiscally liberal manner.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“Furthermore, the recent 'Black Tue..."
entries.dialogueText: “Furthermore, the recent 'Black Tuesday' event caused dramatic economic upheavals in Sordland and the wider region.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“The Central Bank has begun working..."
entries.dialogueText: “The Central Bank has begun working on a bill with the Grand National Assembly to increase our preparedness for future damaging economic incidents.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“I am looking forward to further co..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am looking forward to further collaboration between our departments to solve upcoming issues.”

entries.speaker: Mikail Aven
entries.title: Mikail Aven: "“The NBC will also lend support to..."
entries.dialogueText: “The NBC will also lend support to the analysis and contingency plans regarding the ongoing developments.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“The issues surrounding the energy..."
entries.dialogueText: “The issues surrounding the energy prices and the imbalance they cause in the market are also of pressing concern. Average citizens and businesses are suffering.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“After the Central Bank Reinforceme..."
entries.dialogueText: “After the Central Bank Reinforcement Act, our focus will shift to primarily tackle the energy inflation crisis in the country. We will present a bill about this in the near future if the situation regresses.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“We are tackling these with measure..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are tackling these with measures we have in our power at the C.B. to stabilize the market.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Our treasury is in a dangerous amo..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our treasury is in a dangerous amount of debt.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“If we don't reduce our debt in the..."
entries.dialogueText: “If we don't reduce our debt in the future we might fall in a debt crisis or worse.”

entries.menuText: “What are you suggestions on tackling this?”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “I have to stop spending.”
entries.menuText: “I have to stop spending.”

entries.title: Symon Holl: "“I will work on some proposals rega..."

entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“Furthermore, the recent 'Trade War..."
entries.dialogueText: “Furthermore, the recent 'Trade War' has caused dramatic economic upheavals in the wider region and Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“If we don't invest our resources w..."
entries.dialogueText: “If we don't invest our resources when the country needs it, our future might be in a state of uncertainty.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Rizia's Gasom co-investment has bo..."
entries.dialogueText: “Rizia's Gasom co-investment has boosted our position in the region, but our failure to sign a significant trade deal with our neighbors has raised concerns.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“This has caused some imports and e..."
entries.dialogueText: “This has caused some imports and exports to drop."
